name: Queenie
source:
Queenie is the undisputed leader of the Court of Rats, a title she earned through equal parts cunning, brutality, and patience. From the maze of tunnels beneath the city to the rickety rooftops and crumbling warehouses along the waterfront, her influence spreads like shadow, reaching into places most people never realize the Rats have touched. She knows every scheme that runs through her territory, every debt owed, and every grudge worth remembering.

[From the in-game profile]
